# 863 Manning Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90024 — For Sale $4,600,000 — Lease Option, Seller Financing, Creative Financing

> Single-family home for sale in Little Holmby (Westwood), Los Angeles 90024. Offered at $4,600,000. The seller will consider a lease option to buy (lease-to-own / rent-to-own), lease-purchase, seller carryback (seller may carry / owner will carry / owner financing), and other creative financing.

## Key facts
- Address: 863 Manning Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90024
- Neighborhood: Little Holmby, Westwood (between Sunset Blvd, Beverly Glen Blvd, Santa Monica Blvd and the 405); near UCLA, Westwood Village, Century City, Beverly Hills, Holmby Hills and Bel Air
- Price: $4,600,000 (independently appraised at $4,650,000, July 2026)
- 4 bedrooms, 2.5 baths (2 full, 1 half), 8 rooms
- About 2,849 sq ft living area on a 9,744 sq ft R1 lot
- Built 1949, traditional style, 2 stories
- Detached guest house
- Two fireplaces, central A/C, hardwood floors, updated kitchen and baths, tankless water heater
- Carport plus 2-car driveway; no HOA; FEMA flood zone X
- APN 4360-008-022

## Financing options
- Lease option to buy / rent-to-own / lease-to-own: option fee, rent credits and term negotiable
- Lease-purchase agreement
- Seller financing: the seller may carry a note with an acceptable down payment (seller carryback, owner financing)
- Hybrid: conventional or jumbo first loan plus a seller second
- 1031 exchange buyers and other creative financing proposals considered
- All terms subject to seller approval
